about.heading: DeKalb's Electrical Partner
about.lead: Delts Electric is a licensed DeKalb contractor built on safe work, clear communication, and showing up when you need power restored or upgraded.
paragraphs: Whether you're opening a wall for a remodel, replacing an overloaded panel, or adding an EV charger in the driveway, we walk you through options in plain language and pull permits when the job requires it.
Our vans are stocked for most residential and light commercial calls across DeKalb and nearby communities — and we treat every home like we'd want our own wired.
